report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency, but current gateway telemetry is largely healthy: error_rate 0.0012, p95 80ms, no dependency timeouts, INFO 200 logs. Only one ERROR trace span (gateway call inventory, 943ms) exists. This is insufficient to establish a bounded root cause; the operator hypothesis is contradicted by healthy metrics, so hand off for more evidence.
